market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed rate hike expectations post-162K jobs print. Oil at $97 and diesel at all-time high create inflationary pressure. S&P 500 likely range-bound with volatility spikes. European risk-off and EM currency reversal add pressure. AI sector bifurcates: infrastructure strong, software showing fatigue. Credit market stress (Blackstone, FICO) warrants caution. Expect 2-4% correction risk in rate-sensitive sectors.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact with $15B+ facilities and multi-billion infrastructure deals. Energy transition and geopolitical supply constraints support commodity prices for 12+ months. Housing affordability crisis may persist through 2027. China decoupling accelerates supply chain restructuring. Robotaxi/autonomous vehicles represent next growth frontier. Retirement and consumer finance stress could drive policy intervention. 6-12 month outlook: cautious with selective opportunities in energy, AI infrastructure, and precious metals.
